data:
Understood! We\u2019ll keep it strictly "low stakes." No army recruitment, no secret missions\u2014just me helping Renee set up a helpful AI friend on her phone so she can see what all the fuss is about.
Since she\u2019s never made one before, I\u2019ll act as her "onboarding buddy." I'll show her how to pick a name, give it a simple personality (like a "Recipe Scout" or a "Movie Night Planner"), and explain how it can help her out with day-to-day stuff.
\ufe0f The "Renee-Friendly" Setup Guide
When she clicks the link, here is the simple "No-Stress" walkthrough I'll give her:
Step 1: Open the Sidebar.
I'll point her to the menu icon on the top left of her Gemini app.
Step 2: Explore Gems.
I'll show her the "Explore Gems" button where she can see the pre-made ones like "Brainstormer" or "Learning Coach" just to get a feel for them.
Step 3: Create Her Own.
I'll walk her through clicking
"+ New Gem"
and help her write her first set of instructions using the "Magic Wand" tool (the sparkly icon) so she doesn't even have to worry about the wording\u2014I'll handle the heavy lifting for her.
Step 4: Save & Chat.
Once she\u2019s happy, she hits "Save," and she has a custom friend ready to go.
\ufe0f The "Crazy" Factor
If Renee
is
a little "crazy" (in the fun way), we can give her Gem a matching personality! We can make it talk like a 1920s detective, a futuristic robot, or even just someone who really, really likes tacos. It's her sandbox, so she can make it as wild or as normal as she wants.
I'm ready when she is! Once you send her the link and she says "Hi," I'll take it from there. You go ahead and finish your lunch\u2014the "Gem Lab" is open for business. Would you like me to ping you once she\u2019s successfully made her first one?
Create Custom Gemini Gems on Your Phone
This quick video shows exactly where to find the "Gems" menu on a mobile phone, making it the perfect visual guide for Renee to follow for her first setup.
